prior_implementation_fact.S3: Prior S3 leaves State resident in A coordinates; PBR only surrounds codec via index_select(-2) and inverse after decode. New S3 must instead keep State in A@P coordinates and apply no P during QDQ.

normalization_and_scale.native_norm: l2norm(value)=value*rsqrt(sum(value*value)+1e-6), evaluated at original BF16 q/k dtype before FP32 cast in actual Torch helper; preserve operation graph and dtype.
normalization_and_scale.new_prepare: Normalize Q/K once at uniquehead16 before duplication, cast toFP32, apply batched rowvector @A; S3 then index_select(lastaxis,P).
normalization_and_scale.query_scale: 1/sqrt128 applied once inside unchanged original helper; do not preapply scale in prepare.
normalization_and_scale.kernel_flag: Set both calls use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=False only after actual new prepare; audit actual invocation counters.
normalization_and_scale.double_rotation_hazard: Do not concurrently enter old QwenKeyHadamardPatch or RotationPatch: they would repeat normalization/rotation.
normalization_and_scale.Cq_coordinate: Frozen moments were collected from normalized/scaled native Query, not H Query. Direct native row q@A with A=U@H therefore matches requested R.T@q column convention.
normalization_and_scale.H_transition_if_used: If an H-input interface is separately exposed, q_H@(H.T@U@H) equals native q@(U@H) in exact arithmetic; do not apply both direct A and transition.

new_architecture.C1: qrow=q_native_norm.float@A; krow=k_native_norm.float@A; resident S=A.T@S_native; helper update/readout directly in resident coordinates.
new_architecture.S3: qrow=(q_native_norm.float@A)[P]; krow=(k_native_norm.float@A)[P]; resident S=(A@P).T@S_native. Since P bit-reversal is involution, index_select matches P multiplication; still explicitly verify permutation/inverse.
new_architecture.QDQ: Unchanged B1 symmetric group32 codec directly on resident [B,32,128,128] State, no coordinate transformation or permutation inside encode/decode.
new_architecture.cache: Fresh zero native State maps to zero resident State. Never migrate an existing P1 cache. Native helper returns FP32 State and cache keeps it; subsequent helper consumes exactly QDQ decoded State.
new_architecture.readout: Value axis unchanged: transformed q dot transformed State returns native value-space vector; no inverse output State rotation required.
new_architecture.resident_static_matrix_size: 24*16*128*128*4=25165824bytes per deployed A, versus prior duplicated32-head A50331648bytes.
new_architecture.vector_rotation_suggestion: Stack Q/K into 2x16 batched vectors and perform one layer-level bmm/einsum against 16 A matrices; no perhead Python loop. Verify numerical differences diagnostically and preserve exact chosen graph thereafter.

performance_audit.unprofiled_measurement: One process per condition; synchronize at window boundaries, no observers/hash/tensor copying inside measured windows; keep genuine QDQ and mandatory finite checks. Record initial prompt token0 chunk and later recurrent/decode separately; a teacher replay without sampling is not free-generation TPS.
performance_audit.components: Record CUDA events around batched QK prepare, unchanged recurrent/chunk helper, QDQ; separately record host time/synchronization. CUDA event pairs are asynchronous; synchronize/read after window, not perhead.
performance_audit.launch_counts: Use a separate short bounded torch.profiler CPU+CUDA window with named ranges for QK/GDN/QDQ and actual CUDA kernel events. Exclude profiler TPS from unprofiled throughput; report counted kernels per token/layer.
performance_audit.structural_proof: Audit AST+actual shapes/call counters/profiler: dense matmul operands only Q/K vector/headbatch against static128x128 A. No State-shaped 128x128@128x128 transforms. Exactly24*16 Q and24*16 K rotations/token, zero extraState rotations, one native helper/layer/token,24 QDQ writes/token.

If consolidated to one token-level finite decision, retain exact code/scale arithmetic bytes and demonstrate actual finite/error behavior before one freeze; do not hide finite checks or silently omit them.
